name: Zinge's Delivery
summary: Apothecary Renferrel sends Zinge's Delivery from the Sepulcher to the Undercity. The wolf hearts he sends from Silverpine Forest carry toxins that should have killed the beasts, and Apothecary Zinge receives them for study by the Royal Apothecary Society.

sections.title: A Toxic Anomaly
sections.body: Apothecary Renferrel found a strange trait in the wolves roaming Silverpine Forest's ruined woods. Their hearts held such powerful toxins that they should have killed the beasts. Renferrel preserved several tissue samples and packed them for colleagues at the Apothecarium in the Undercity.

sections.title: The Eyes of the Apothecarium
sections.body: Apothecary Zinge receives the preserved organs at the Undercity's underground headquarters of the Royal Apothecary Society. The society seeks potent plagues and new alchemical compounds, so poisons that sustain their hosts draw its attention. Zinge welcomes the samples as the start of further laboratory trials across the Forsaken alchemical network.

faq.q: What are the wolf heart samples?
faq.answer: The samples are preserved tissue from wolves in Silverpine Forest. Apothecary Renferrel found natural toxins in their hearts so deadly the animals should not have survived carrying them.

Apothecary Renferrel is a member of the Royal Apothecary Society stationed at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. He leads field research on regional plants and animals to gather ingredients and knowledge for Forsaken alchemy.
Apothecary Zinge is an alchemical researcher in the Apothecarium quarter of the Undercity. She studies incoming biological specimens for new toxins and alchemical agents for the Forsaken.

faq.q: Where does this delivery lead next?
faq.answer: Apothecary Zinge receives and inspects the strange heart tissue, then samples go to other alchemical outposts. One such outpost is Apothecary Helbrim's, across the sea in the Barrens.

faq.q: Why is the Royal Apothecary Society interested in wolf hearts?
aliases: why do apothecaries want wolf hearts
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society seeks unusual poisons, diseases, and biological anomalies. A beast that survives lethal toxins in its own heart may reveal chemical paths to new plagues and compounds.

faq.q: Where is the Apothecarium in Undercity?
faq.answer: The Apothecarium occupies the southwestern wing of the Undercity. It is the Royal Apothecary Society's main laboratory complex and headquarters.

angles.text: As an Undead, you know field samples from Lordaeron reach the alchemical laboratories beneath the Capital City ruins and advance Forsaken science.
As a member of the Horde, you know messengers carrying biological reagents link distant outposts like the Sepulcher with the Undercity's leaders and research halls.
